ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to restrict changing of role to 'guarantor' if its primary applicant
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", !ISNEW(), Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName == 'MLCRM_Opportunity', ISCHANGED(Role), Contact.AccountId == Opportunity.AccountId , Text(Role) == 'Guarantor' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You don't have sufficient privileges to change the role of primary customer. Please contact system administrator
